title: Upstream entry (v1)
description: One request of a multi-request command invocation, an element of data.upstream's ordered array: the zero-based request index within the invocation, that exchange's metadata, and the lossless decoded body tree. The array-of-entries form is the discriminator of a multi-request invocation; a single-request command emits the bare body value instead.

meta.$comment: The per-exchange metadata of this one request: the envelope meta members except warnings, plus the optional pacing wait that preceded the request.

waited_ms.$comment: Present only when an exhausted rate window paced this request: the whole milliseconds waited for that window's reset before dispatching it.

body.$comment: The lossless decoded upstream JSON value of this request's response body.
